Name: Daily News
Author: bashNinja
Description:
This Mod adds a News Channel to Stardew Valley.

[img]https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/5581855/25777459/443cd26e-329b-11e7-9b9f-d78496c194e3.png[/img]
 
The channel airs every Tue, Fri, and Sat. 


The news items are chosen randomly from [i]news/*.json[/i] 
Additional config changes can be found in[i] config.json[/i]

Requires [url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]SMAPI 1.15.1[/url]+ & [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1139/]CustomTV 1.12+[/url] & [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1068/]Custom Element Handler 1.13+

[/url]View the[url=https://github.com/miketweaver/DailyNews/tree/v1.1] Source on Github[/url]!
